selected_execution_path.rationale: Among inspected paths, codex_local is already present in supported Paperclip adapter registry readback and the host Codex CLI is available. Hermes has a concrete execution-time authentication blocker, and gsdpi_local has no supported Paperclip registry/testEnvironment boundary despite a plausible local adapter package.
guardrails: A later task must perform a bounded smoke through supported Paperclip APIs before promoting Codex execution.
Do not configure plaintext provider secrets or print credential values.
Do not patch Paperclip core, mutate database rows, or import private registry internals.
If Codex smoke lacks a structured BOS result shape, keep execution no-go.
